title: Introduce cooperative KV copy-on-write snapshotting and staggered prefetch to reduce cold-start stalls
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Background: In the last two quarters we've observed recurring 'startup stalls' when model replicas are brought online or when tenant load spikes trigger slot allocation. Root cause analysis points to aggressive synchronous prefetch + global KV checkpointing during lease acquisition which creates short-lived contention on IO and scheduler lanes. Goal: Implement a cooperative copy-on-write (COW) snapshot path for kvcache checkpoints and a staggered (cooperative) prefetch schedule that reduces tail latencies during replica warmup without increasing steady-state cost. Scope: runtime serving (kvcache, prefetch controller, slot allocator, scheduler backpressure hooks). Out of scope: user-visible API changes, dedicated capacity autoscaler tuning (follow-on). Constraints: must be safe for concurrent readers, backwards-compatible with existing checkpoint format, and toggleable via runtime feature flag for staged rollout.
acceptance_criteria: Reduce p95 cold-start latency for replica warmup on standard 8xA100 host from baseline by >=40% in staging
No increase (>2%) in median token latency under 99th-percentile traffic bursts in canary compared to prod baseline
Introduce a feature-flag gated COW snapshot that can be toggled without requiring model restarts
Add observability: per-slot warmup duration metric, prefetch phases histogram, and kvcache-snapshot I/O duration traces
All new code covered by unit tests and integration test that simulates concurrent prefetch + eviction races
comments: 2025-02-28 — Aisha Patel: Created ticket after correlating recent incidents (INC-2241, INC-2260) with kvcache checkpoint spikes. Initial perf runs show p95 warmup = 780ms on standard config.

2025-03-01 — Diego Martinez: Spike profiling shows 60% of warmup time spent in 'kv_snapshot_write' and scheduler lock contention. Proposed approach: create COW-snapshot that marks pages as shared and performs background copy-on-write during quiet windows; coordinate with scheduler to stagger prefetch by slot priority.

2025-03-03 — Design review notes (Parul Shah): Prefer staged rollout with feature flag and telemetry. Concern: COW increases memory transiently — need safety cap and OOM guard. Action: add 'max_cow_memory_pct' and fallback to legacy path when exceeded.

2025-03-04 — Implementation update (Diego): Proof-of-concept implemented for COW snapshot; integrated basic prefetch stages (metadata-only, small-key prime, full-body). Added internal metric 'slot_warmup_phase' and 'kvcow_bytes_allocated'. Local CI + unit tests green. Filing PR #GH-5824 for initial review.

2025-03-05 — Perf note (SRE): Staging run with COW + staggered prefetch shows p95 warmup reduced to ~210ms (from 780ms) on 8xA100 profile; p50 unchanged. Need larger canary validation across mixed tenant traffic to validate contention behavior.

2025-03-06 — Security/Compliance (Marta Ruiz): No secrets introduced. Confirmed snapshot format unchanged; only on-disk artifacts have same encryption path. Recommend brief design note for audit logs — added to linked_confluence.

2025-03-07 — Diego: Merged follow-up unit tests into branch. Next: implement OOM guard and scheduler-integrated backpressure hint. Planning to create two sub-tasks for telemetry cleanup and canary rollout plan.
